description: Inventaire des buses sur le réseau routier national en Guyane is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.geoguyane.fr. A nozzle is a hydraulic or road structure of tubular shape, made of reinforced concrete, metal, within an embankment. Note: The nozzles can be circular, arched, ovoid in shape... The data shows the known nozzles on the national road network of Guyana. The data geolocates the nozzles on the national road network in French Guiana. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Inventory of nozzles on the national road network in French Guiana" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
